product_title: Crayola Colored Pencils (36ct), Kids Pencil Set, Back to School Essentials, Must Have Classroom Supplies for Kids, Pre-Sharpened Coloring Book Pencils, 3+
review_text: I’ve come to suspect that companies use Amazon to dump their ‘2nds’ (aka: defective) products. This purchase was yet another example. Box seemed a little odd on arrival. Like the pencils were having trouble fitting in it, which was odd. After taking them out, then trying unsuccessfully to return them to the box, I realized why. A bunch of them are warped. Slight curves and bends throughout. Isn’t noticeable when they’re sitting in a pencil cup. And still work just fine. But won’t be keeping them in the box for storage as I normally would, as they don’t fit. Keeping for the grandkids. But shall be buying myself another set (locally) that I can keep in the box so it can stay with my other to-go office supplies. And not sit in a pencil holder on my desk.

They offer vibrant colors that blend beautifully, allowing for smooth gradients and detailed shading. Whether you’re using wax-based, oil-based, or watercolor pencils, they provide endless creative possibilities. I love how portable and easy to use they are perfect for sketching on the go or creating intricate artwork at home. Plus, they’re available in a wide range of sets, from basic to professional grade, so there’s something for everyone. Highly recommend for anyone looking to explore their artistic side!
